description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The State of Missouri is hiring a Web Developer to support agency and enterprise websites. The role updates web content and pages, assists agency users, troubleshoots site issues, and helps ensure accessibility standards are met.
Web Developer supporting Drupal and WordPress agency websites through content updates, page creation, troubleshooting, and accessibility remediation

Responsibilities:
• Provide daily support to agency users through updates to content, training staff, participating in projects, troubleshooting site issues as well as checks and remediation to enforce accessibility standards
• Completes page changes, uploads documents, and creates new web pages (as well as deleting them) for agency staff
• Understands basic HTML, CSS, JS, PHP
• Make updates to the sites we have in content management systems (Drupal and WordPress)

Requirements:
• Authorization to work in the United States
• Understands basic HTML, CSS, JS, PHP
• Possess a customer-focused approach
• Knowledge of the core programming language used in the assigned area, such as HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript
• Knowledge of computer logic statements and their applications
• Ability to learn and apply concepts
• Ability to perform basic mathematics
• Ability to provide logical and innovative ideas and think critically to resolve issues
• Ability to communicate with staff, management, and agency personnel
